{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Desserts]]
==Ingredients==
*110 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (3.9 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] / 1 stick) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], plus extra for greasing
*180 g (6.3 oz / 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]) soft light [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
*1 large [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
*225 g (7.9 oz / 1¾ cups) plain [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*30 g (1.1 oz / ¼ cup) [[Cookbook:Cocoa Powder|cocoa powder]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|bicarbonate of soda]]
*¼ tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*60 g (2.1 oz / ¾ cup) white [[Cookbook:Chocolate Chips|chocolate chips]]
*60 g (2.1 oz / ¾ cup) milk chocolate chips

== Procedure ==
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to {{Convert|190|C|F|abbr=on}}. Grease 3 [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking trays]].
#Mix the flour, cocoa, bicarbonate of soda and salt in a bowl.
#[[Cookbook:Beating|Beat]] the butter and sugar in a mixing bowl until soft and fluffy.
#Beat in the egg.
#[[Cookbook:Folding|Fold]] the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients.
#Fold the chocolate chips into the dough.
#Spoon heaped tablespoons of dough onto the baking trays, well spaced apart.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 12–15 minutes. If you want a chewy texture, reduce the time to 10 minutes.
#Transfer the cookies to [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|wire racks]] and leave them to cool.
#Enjoy!
